audit_status.source_base: Greek 1 Peter text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact draft reviewed for shepherding elders, no domination, humility, anxiety cast on Divine, adversarial vigilance, restoration, final greetings.

verses.restored: Therefore I appeal to elders among you, fellow elder and witness of Messiah's sufferings and partner of glory about to be unveiled:

familiar.text: The elders which are among you I exhort, who am also an elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and also a partaker of the glory that shall be revealed:

modern.text: As a fellow elder, a witness of Christ’s sufferings, and a partaker of the glory to be revealed, I appeal to the elders among you:

original.text: Πρεσβυτέρους ⸀οὖν ἐν ὑμῖν παρακαλῶ ὁ συμπρεσβύτερος καὶ μάρτυς τῶν τοῦ Χριστοῦ παθημάτων, ὁ καὶ τῆς μελλούσης ἀποκαλύπτεσθαι δόξης κοινωνός,

verses.restored: shepherd the flock of the Divine among you, overseeing not by compulsion but willingly according to Divine, not for shameful gain but eagerly,

familiar.text: Feed the flock of God which is among you, taking the oversight thereof, not by constraint, but willingly; not for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind;

modern.text: Be shepherds of God’s flock that is among you, watching over them not out of compulsion, but because it is God’s will; not out of greed, but out of eagerness;

original.text: ποιμάνατε τὸ ἐν ὑμῖν ποίμνιον τοῦ θεοῦ, ⸀ἐπισκοποῦντες μὴ ἀναγκαστῶς ἀλλὰ ἑκουσίως ⸂κατὰ θεόν⸃, μηδὲ αἰσχροκερδῶς ἀλλὰ προθύμως,

verses.restored: not as lording over those allotted to you, but becoming patterns for the flock.

familiar.text: Neither as being lords over God’s heritage, but being ensamples to the flock.

modern.text: not lording it over those entrusted to you, but being examples to the flock.

original.text: μηδʼ ὡς κατακυριεύοντες τῶν κλήρων ἀλλὰ τύποι γινόμενοι τοῦ ποιμνίου·

verses.restored: And when the chief Shepherd is manifested, you will receive the unfading crown of glory.

familiar.text: And when the chief Shepherd shall appear, ye shall receive a crown of glory that fadeth not away.

modern.text: And when the Chief Shepherd appears, you will receive the crown of glory that will never fade away. Cast Your Cares on Him

original.text: καὶ φανερωθέντος τοῦ ἀρχιποίμενος κομιεῖσθε τὸν ἀμαράντινον τῆς δόξης στέφανον.

verses.restored: Likewise younger ones, be arranged under elders; and all of you clothe yourselves with humility toward one another, because the Divine opposes arrogant ones but gives grace to humble ones.

familiar.text: Likewise, ye younger, submit yourselves unto the elder. Yea, all of you be subject one to another, and be clothed with humility: for God resisteth the proud, and giveth grace to the humble.

modern.text: Young men, in the same way, submit yourselves to your elders. And all of you, clothe yourselves with humility toward one another, because, “God opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”

original.text: ὁμοίως, νεώτεροι, ὑποτάγητε πρεσβυτέροις. πάντες δὲ ⸀ἀλλήλοις τὴν ταπεινοφροσύνην ἐγκομβώσασθε, ὅτι Ὁ θεὸς ὑπερηφάνοις ἀντιτάσσεται ταπεινοῖς δὲ δίδωσιν χάριν.

verses.restored: Therefore be humbled under the mighty hand of the Divine, so that he may lift you in season,

familiar.text: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time:

modern.text: Humble yourselves, therefore, under God’s mighty hand, so that in due time He may exalt you.

original.text: Ταπεινώθητε οὖν ὑπὸ τὴν κραταιὰν χεῖρα τοῦ θεοῦ, ἵνα ὑμᾶς ὑψώσῃ ἐν καιρῷ,

verses.restored: casting all your anxiety upon him, because he cares concerning you.

familiar.text: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.

modern.text: Cast all your anxiety on Him, because He cares for you.

original.text: πᾶσαν τὴν μέριμναν ὑμῶν ἐπιρίψαντες ἐπʼ αὐτόν, ὅτι αὐτῷ μέλει περὶ ὑμῶν.

verses.restored: Be sober; keep awake. Your adversary, the accuser, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to swallow.

familiar.text: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:

modern.text: Be sober-minded and alert. Your adversary the devil prowls around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour.

original.text: νήψατε, γρηγορήσατε. ὁ ἀντίδικος ὑμῶν διάβολος ὡς λέων ὠρυόμενος περιπατεῖ ζητῶν ⸀τινα ⸀καταπιεῖν·

verses.restored: Resist him, firm in trust, knowing the same sufferings are being completed in your siblinghood in the world.

familiar.text: Whom resist stedfast in the faith, knowing that the same afflictions are accomplished in your brethren that are in the world.

modern.text: Resist him, standing firm in your faith and in the knowledge that your brothers throughout the world are undergoing the same kinds of suffering. Benediction and Farewell

original.text: ᾧ ἀντίστητε στερεοὶ τῇ πίστει, εἰδότες τὰ αὐτὰ τῶν παθημάτων τῇ ἐν ⸀τῷ κόσμῳ ὑμῶν ἀδελφότητι ἐπιτελεῖσθαι.

verses.restored: And the Divine of all grace, the One calling you into his age-long glory in Messiah, after you have suffered a little, will himself restore, establish, strengthen, and ground you.

familiar.text: But the God of all grace, who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.

modern.text: And after you have suffered for a little while, the God of all grace, who has called you to His eternal glory in Christ, will Himself restore you, secure you, strengthen you, and establish you.

original.text: ὁ δὲ θεὸς πάσης χάριτος, ὁ καλέσας ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν αἰώνιον αὐτοῦ δόξαν ἐν ⸀Χριστῷ, ὀλίγον παθόντας αὐτὸς ⸀καταρτίσει, στηρίξει, σθενώσει, ⸀θεμελιώσει.

verses.restored: To him be dominion into the ages. Amen.

familiar.text: To him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

modern.text: To Him be the power forever and ever. Amen.

original.text: ⸀αὐτῷ τὸ κράτος εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας ⸂τῶν αἰώνων⸃· ἀμήν.

verses.restored: Through Silvanus, the trustworthy sibling as I consider, I wrote briefly, appealing and testifying this to be true grace of the Divine. Stand in it.

familiar.text: By Silvanus, a faithful brother unto you, as I suppose, I have written briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God wherein ye stand.

modern.text: Through Silvanus, whom I regard as a faithful brother, I have written to you briefly, encouraging you and testifying that this is the true grace of God. Stand firm in it.

original.text: Διὰ Σιλουανοῦ ὑμῖν τοῦ πιστοῦ ἀδελφοῦ, ὡς λογίζομαι, διʼ ὀλίγων ἔγραψα, παρακαλῶν καὶ ἐπιμαρτυρῶν ταύτην εἶναι ἀληθῆ χάριν τοῦ θεοῦ· εἰς ἣν ⸀στῆτε.

verses.restored: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you, and Mark my son.

familiar.text: The church that is at Babylon, elected together with you, saluteth you; and so doth Marcus my son.

modern.text: The church in Babylon, chosen together with you, sends you greetings, as does my son Mark.

original.text: ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς ἡ ἐν Βαβυλῶνι συνεκλεκτὴ καὶ Μᾶρκος ὁ υἱός μου.

verses.restored: Greet one another with kiss of love. Peace to all of you in Messiah.

familiar.text: Greet ye one another with a kiss of charity. Peace be with you all that are in Christ Jesus. Amen.

modern.text: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace to all of you who are in Christ.

original.text: ἀσπάσασθε ἀλλήλους ἐν φιλήματι ἀγάπης. εἰρήνη ὑμῖν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἐν ⸀Χριστῷ.

translation_notes: Eldership/shepherding is explicitly non-domineering; leaders are patterns, not lords over the flock.
Anxiety is cast on Divine care, not dismissed.
The adversarial lion image is vigilance language; do not turn people into the enemy.
